title: Elevated 5xx errors on api-gateway
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-04-13 05:28-08:18: api-gateway: 141 of 212 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-04-13 05:28 and 2026-04-13 08:18 UTC (peak error ratio 1.0 vs baseline median 0.0). 3 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 0.547 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.
error_templates: unhandled error in request handler: <*> failures in 60 s

_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) changes the condition / constant shown in the diff.

culprit.diff:
@@ -222,3 +222,3 @@ map_request
         cached = self._cache.get(key)
-        if not cached:
+        if cached:
             cached = self._fetch(key)

rca.macro: Deploy v2.16.0 of api-gateway introduced a regression.
rca.micro: gateway/transforms/request_mapper.py:223 (map_request) changes the condition / constant shown in the diff.
rca.remediation: Roll back api-gateway v2.16.0 -> v2.15.0; revert gateway/transforms/request_mapper.py:223.

action_items: Add a regression test covering map_request (gateway/transforms/request_mapper.py).
